name: SpaceSense-Bench
description:
SpaceSense-Bench: Multi-Modal Spacecraft Perception and Pose Estimation Dataset
	

Project Page | Paper | Toolkit & Code
SpaceSense-Bench is a high-fidelity simulation-based multi-modal (RGB, Depth, LiDAR Point Cloud) dataset for spacecraft component-level semantic understanding, containing 136 satellite models with synchronized multi-modal data.

evaluation_method: task-specific metrics (mAP for detection, mIoU for segmentation, ADD/ADD-S for 6D pose, Chamfer/IoU for point-cloud tasks)
reputation: A specialized, simulation-driven dataset gaining attention in space-robotics and spacecraft perception research communities; available on Hugging Face but not yet a mainstream benchmark.
